items.title: File Einspruch against KFZ tax assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.
items.computation: Letter is dated and presumably posted on 20.11.2026 (Friday). Per the deemed-delivery rule stated (and matching the current § 122 Abs. 2 AO / § 108 AO rule in force since the 2025 reform of the Bekanntgabefiktion), delivery is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting: 20.11 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday) — not a weekend/holiday in NW, so it stands as the Bekanntgabe date. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO in conjunction with § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (24.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month Einspruch period (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) therefore ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12.2026 is not a statutory public holiday in NW (only 25./26.12 are holidays), so the deadline is not shifted.

items.title: Annual Kraftfahrzeugsteuer collected by direct debit
items.quote: Den Betrag buchen wir vom angegebenen Konto ab.
items.computation: The letter states the tax is set at 146,00 € per year, effective from the registration date 02.11.2026, and will be collected by SEPA direct debit from the account on file, but no specific debit date is given in the letter.

warnings: The letter does not state a specific date on which the 146,00 € will actually be debited by direct debit; only that it will be 'am angegebenen Konto' collected automatically.

The deemed-delivery period of 'four days after posting' matches the rule currently in force in Germany since the 2024/2025 reform of § 122 Abs. 2 AO (previously three days); if this letter were governed by the older three-day rule, the Einspruch deadline would be one day earlier (23.12.2026).
